plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for TBS / Skylone IPTV-DVB headend gateways (enterprise PEN 51009, SKYLONE-MIB). Besides standard IF-MIB interface traffic and uptime, it reports CPU and memory usage and per-transponder signal strength, SNR and bitrate.
name: Transmission

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU usage of the TBS / Skylone IPTV-DVB headend gateway in percent (SKYLONE-MIB sysResourceCPU scalar).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory usage of the TBS / Skylone IPTV-DVB headend gateway in percent (SKYLONE-MIB sysResourceMEM scalar).

metrics.name: tbs_transponder_signal_strength
metrics.description: Raw per-transponder signal strength from SKYLONE-MIB tpStrength, stored as reported by the device with no scaling.

metrics.name: tbs_transponder_snr
metrics.description: Raw per-transponder SNR from SKYLONE-MIB tpSnr, stored as reported by the device with no scaling.

metrics.name: tbs_transponder_bitrate
metrics.description: Raw per-transponder bitrate from SKYLONE-MIB tpBitrate, stored as reported by the device with no scaling.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: device_total_incoming_traffic
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of total bytes received by the entire device over the past 5 minutes, summed from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counters.

metrics.name: device_total_outgoing_traffic
metrics.description: This metric represents the average rate of total bytes sent by the entire device over the past 5 minutes, summed from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counters.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
